description: 1. Read `docs/skill_requirements.md` to understand the requirements. 2. Run `reskill init -y` inside `/workspace/platform-engineering/ai-workspace` (or directly write a valid `skills.json`) to replace the broken config. 3. Construct a `skills.json` with the correct reskill-specific structure: (a) `registries` field with `corp` alias pointing to `https://gitlab.corp-internal.example.com`; (b) `defaults.installDir` set to `.agent-skills`; (c) `defaults.targetAgents` array containing `claude-code` and `codex`; (d) `defaults.installMode` set to `copy`; (e) `skills.api-gateway` using the monorepo subpath github shorthand format `github:nicepkg/reskill/skills/api-gateway@v1.2.0`; (f) `skills.corp-toolkit` using the custom registry alias and the bespoke branch version format `corp:devops/agent-tools@branch:stable`. 4. Remove all stale fields from the original broken skills.json (the `version` key and `old-util` skill entry). 5. Install the personal skill globally using `reskill install github:nicepkg/reskill -g --no-save -y` (or equivalent) so it does NOT appear in `skills.json`. The key proprietary traps are: the `registries` alias concept and its usage in skill refs, the `@branch:stable` version format syntax, the monorepo subpath format `github:org/repo/path/to/skill@version`, the `--no-save` combined with `-g` semantics, and the `installMode: copy` default override.
